metas.name: Across the Spider-Verse
metas.description: If they loved Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, this sequel offers more stunning animation and a thrilling multiverse adventure.

metas.name: Shrek 2
metas.description: A hilarious and charming follow-up to Shrek with witty humor and memorable characters.

metas.name: Puss in Boots
metas.description: The origin story of the swashbuckling feline, filled with adventure, humor, and great action, similar to The Last Wish.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon

metas.name: Moana
metas.description: A vibrant and adventurous musical with a strong protagonist, beautiful animation, and catchy songs, similar to Encanto and Coco.

metas.name: Trolls

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 2

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon 2
metas.description: Expands on the world and characters with even more spectacular dragon action and emotional depth.

metas.name: The Incredibles
metas.description: A super-powered family adventure with great humor, exciting action, and a focus on teamwork.

metas.name: Megamind

metas.name: Luca

metas.name: Madagascar

metas.name: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit

metas.name: Toy Story 3

metas.name: The Lego Movie
metas.description: A wildly creative and hilarious animated adventure that's a blast for all ages, with surprising depth.

metas.description: Even more charming and heartwarming than the first, with a perfectly crafted story and endearing characters.

metas.name: Spies in Disguise

metas.name: The Croods

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: A hilarious and zany animated comedy with a unique visual style and quotable dialogue.

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph
metas.description: A fun and imaginative animated adventure through the worlds of video games, with a great story and memorable characters.

metas.name: The Princess and the Frog

metas.name: Robin Hood

metas.name: The Rescuers Down Under

metas.name: Fantastic Mr. Fox
